name: SideNav
purpose: The persistent vertical navigation rail of an app shell — brand mark, primary nav entries, and a footer slot for the current user.
neverUseFor: Breadcrumbs — SideNav is persistent app-level nav, breadcrumbs are per-page wayfinding
Anything other than NavItem as its direct nav entries — don't put a Button or a plain <a> among the items
rationale: SideNav is the persistent <nav> rail of the app shell with a fixed 224px chrome width — a standalone dimension documented in component-token-exceptions.md. It accepts only NavItems as entries so every app's navigation shares the same link semantics and active styling.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the brand mark, NavItems and footer content
mustEscalateToDS: Changing the 224px width or adding a collapsed/mini mode
Putting Buttons or plain links among the nav entries

anatomy.description: Root — always a native <nav>, fixed width.
Slot at the bottom — typically the current user row.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo/product-name content, rendered at the top.

props.name: children
props.description: The nav entries — a list of NavItem.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content pinned to the bottom — typically the current user.

width.note: 224px, a standalone chrome dimension — no matching primitive/spacing/size rung, documented in component-token-exceptions.md.

properties.name: brand
properties.description: Show/hide part: the brand row carries its own 12px bottom (code's margin-bottom), so hiding it leaves the items where the root's 12px top puts them.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Show/hide part: 8px margin + top border + 8px padding all live on the footer.

figma.structure: No variants — a single component: side-nav-brand > brand-content, side-nav-items (NavItem instances, fills the height), side-nav-footer > footer-content (Avatar instance + name/role).
